doc.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 5, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Listening to band members' ideas, Operation: Entertainment
summary: Gibbs says he is no control freak and took John Audino's suggestion on a tune order for Operation: Entertainment.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Would you describe your — do you think of yourself as a bit of a control freak?

No, not at all. I mean you know what’s so wild? I listen to anybody in the band. For example I wrote all these things where I did a show called “Operation: Entertainment.” I had all these things follow me, a singer, a comedian, you know I had all these things I wrote for the band. And while we rehearsed a singer, and then I picked out what number would play them off, and my trumpet player, John Audino said, “Hey Terry, why don’t we play eight instead of number four.” I said, “Why?” He said, “Because eight’s in the same key as the singer is, you know, we’ll go right into the same key.” I said great. I listened to everybody. If it’s a good idea why not use it? You know I mean like I listen to everybody. That’s how I learn.
